rationale: The source description says Alfabet uses AI technologies to deliver strategic portfolio management. Official Alfabet documentation describes AI portfolio management as a strategic governance tool, with AI use cases/features/models, requiring an Enterprise Architecture Management license and activation. That is an AI functionality of Alfabet, though conditional licensing/use-case applies.
ai_type_rationale: Alfabet's broader enterprise architecture and portfolio management function remains meaningful without its optional AI Portfolio Management governance use case; AI is an enhancement, not the whole core.
version_scope: Description has no version/date. Official documentation is Alfabet 11.11 and explicitly notes Enterprise Architecture Management license plus AI Portfolio Management use-case enablement; not universal for every SKU/version.
issues: AI Portfolio Management is license/activation dependent; record does not identify SKU/version.

sources.excerpt: To work with Alfabet's AI portfolio management capabilities, you must have a license to Enterprise Architecture Management. The use case AI Portfolio Management must be enabled. ... AI Portfolio Management is a strategic AI governance tool designed to provide visibility into the deployment and use of artificial intelligence across your IT architecture.
sources.applicability: Official Alfabet 11.11 help; confirms an AI capability but limits availability to licensed/enabled use case. Source record itself says Alfabet uses AI technologies.
